brief.t: FIRST — close Terra Lotus today: take the verified 22,000-unit scope, complete operating and formula/BOM cost inputs, approve the commercial terms, then send the quote and contract. The July 30 delivery is overdue; no guessed price.

SECOND — recover ELOIRE today with a written 500- and 1,000-unit quote, lead time, and packaging-correction plan, or tell Diana directly PLL cannot take the reorder. Her final follow-up leaves no room for another soft promise.

THIRD — unblock Victor’s 4,000-unit two-SKU opportunity: get the actual R&D packaging-compatibility answer and complete cost inputs before issuing the overdue quote. Do not convert a pending compatibility check into a production promise.

FOURTH — protect Monday’s revenue calls: approve evidence-backed pricing preparation for Rehman’s three-SKU tallow launch and Shay Brands’ 500/1,000/1,500-unit tiers. Rehman is 10:00 AM ET and Shay is 2:00 PM ET Monday.

FIFTH — make Atlas real before Tuesday’s production/pro-forma meeting: verify scope, price basis, and ownership of the pro forma; Kenna is included. The meeting is confirmed for Tuesday at 2:00 PM ET.

SIXTH — reconcile cash and commitments: payroll was confirmed at $14,385.90 after a cancellation/re-run sequence, while a $1,260 Zelle payment and the HP Forklifts invoice need ledger and authorization review. Do not pay from email links.

kb.a: Live CRM shows three urgent Terra Lotus tasks overdue from July 30: Sam approval/delivery, Aidan’s verified operational cost inputs, and Ronald’s formula/BOM inputs. The scope is 22,000 units, not 21,000. Assemble those facts and approved terms before issuing a quote or contract.

Diana’s July 31 final follow-up says PLL still owes written 500- and 1,000-unit pricing, lead time, and a scratch/spotting correction plan promised July 29. Send a verified commercial answer today, or state directly that PLL cannot support the reorder. Do not make another “shortly” promise.

Victor’s 2,000-units-per-SKU Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel quote was due Friday. The Edge Gel is a hot pour with an indicated target near $2.90/unit, but packaging compatibility and full cost inputs remain unverified. Get written R&D confirmation before pricing or committing.

Rehman Ghani Arain is booked Monday, August 3 at 10:00 AM ET (6:00 PM UAE) for a three-SKU private-label tallow balm line: existing base, honey infused, and citrus infused. He is considering 500 units per SKU with potential add-ons and is budget-conscious. Prepare validated 500-unit and higher-tier direction, samples, and US/GCC qualification; no unsupported price.

Jarrod Adams of Shay Brands is booked Monday, August 3 at 2:00 PM ET (11:00 AM PT). He wants a custom whipped tallow moisturizer plus white-label scrub and night cream, with phased hair/body products, and requested 500/1,000/1,500-unit tiers. Prepare validated commercial inputs and qualification questions; the calendar time was rescheduled from an earlier slot.

Atlas accepted the production/pro-forma meeting for Tuesday, August 4 at 2:00 PM ET; Sam, Ryne Bell, and Kenna Whitnell are included. CRM has an Aidan task to send Kenna the Atlas quote. Verify scope, pricing basis, and delivery status before the meeting; do not assume a pro forma has been sent.

Vladimir requested side-by-side EDDS versus EDTA cost direction for treatment shampoo, daily shampoo, and conditioner, at roughly 250–400 units per SKU, plus 3 oz treatment-shampoo feasibility, lead time, CoA/stability, and MoCRA-label support. EDDS is his preferred sustainability direction. Technical feasibility, minimums, documentation scope, and cost inputs are not yet verified; avoid treatment/regulatory claims.

Gusto emails show payroll canceled at $15,297.90, then confirmed at $14,385.90 for July 16–August 1 with a planned July 31 debit; reconcile the final ledger and employee-pay status. A $1,260 Zelle payment to Steven Ayyar and a corrected HP Forklifts invoice also need authorization and ledger linkage. Do not pay from emailed links.

The latest morning Ads safety refresh was blocked from publication because reporting quota and required budget/ad-level permissions were unavailable. It confirmed completed July 31 campaign-scope spend of $27.29 and seven-day spend of $172.74, while prior known over-cap days remain July 28 ($38.40) and July 30 ($34.87). Preserve the validated nightly Ads cache, make no settings changes, and obtain cap/reporting evidence before optimization.

Live CRM is authenticated: the dashboard shows $1,327,800 pipeline, 20 active deals, 20 production projects, and $57,454.99 deposits. The Tasks page shows 11 active tasks and nine overdue; it includes overdue Terra Lotus, Victor, and Atlas items. No CRM records were changed in this refresh.

No new authoritative Ashley/Nymphaea payment or supplier-order evidence appeared in the current CRM, calendar, or inbox pulls. The prior request for a 50% Miron glass-container payment remains contingent on a verified supplier amount and order path. Keep it off Sam’s first lane until that evidence arrives, then send only the verified payment link.

BuffMan equipment remains gated. The forwarded freight quote is USD 8,850 DDP, and hot-fill capability, batch-coding method, equipment configuration, quote inclusions, and final landed cost are not verified. No payment, order, or shipment commitment is authorized from current evidence.

Natugeda needs a factual Hair Oil production stage and next date. CRM is not authenticated and the historical Production Scheduled label is not a current operations fact. Get operations confirmation before customer communication.

PHYLARA is satisfied with the sample but pausing for personal-timeline reasons. The customer requested final formula/specifications and any remaining balance. Confirm release permission, document control, and ledger status before responding.

Salty Pup Newport Beach is a new manufacturing inquiry introduced by Ronald. Susan says the formula is complete and she has bottles, labels, and a label applicator; she seeks the right manufacturing partner. Confirm formula transfer, claims, batch size, compatibility, testing, and production requirements before promising price or timing.

A new web inquiry asks about treatment-strength chelating shampoo. Determine intended claims, active ingredients, target user, quantity, packaging, and budget before making a manufacturing or regulatory representation. Treatment-strength positioning may require classification review.

PLL operates at 24600 N. Industrial Dr., Farmington Hills, MI 48335. Customer notification is complete, but UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and a test workflow remain pending. DTE also sent a start-service reminder that needs completion.
bitop AG’s dunning notice requires ledger matching before payment. Amount, original invoice, and any material or production hold are not verified in this refresh. Do not pay from an email link.
CH Robinson invoice 6247783636 for load 555812351 remains unvalidated. Confirm amount, due date, shipment linkage, and delivery status internally before payment or a customer commitment.
